slug: 2025-12-01 Biometric Digital-ID in Africa - Ten Country Case Studies

systems.owner: National ID Program, led by the Prime Minister's Office through the National Identification Authority
systems.tiers: registration centres across the country, including Addis Ababa Civil Registration and Residency Service Agency branch offices, Ethio telecom (29 locations), Ministry of Revenue (25 locations) and nine banks
over 16,000 kebeles; cards pre-printed or filled in by hand at the kebele office

note: The Ethiopia chapter is about the Fayda digital ID. On civil registration it says only that kebeles issue birth certificates and that the paper-based, decentralised system it describes is the kebele ID; it states nothing about how a civil registration office records a birth or death.
